thread:
Ria: Quick triage: we need to finalize the GA scope for observability this quarter. Focus areas: dashboard cost peek, lightweight trace hooks, route-level cost attribution, and error clustering. Can we make a minimal "ship and iterate" list by EOD?
Alex: I'm thinking MVC: small cost card (last-7d + delta), export CSV, and a permalink to full cost explorer later. Keep deep analytics for post-GA.
Sam: Trace hooks: ship a simple sampling toggle + JSON-config UI. No scripting in GA. Acceptance = API + UI + end-to-end smoke that shows traces for sampled requests.
Jordan: Ops constraint: nothing that increases p95 tail more than 7% or CPU >85% on infra for >10min during canary. Canary plan required before rollout.
Maya: Customers want per-customer line items in the CSV and a human-readable attribution note. For GA: include customer_id + route + token_count.
Lina: UX priority: compact card fits top of the console. Hover shows top-3 routes by cost. If export policy forbids, show disabled state + tooltip. Mock: https://figma.com/s/obs-card-ga
Alex: Proposed GA checklist:
- Cost card: last-7d, delta, top-3 routes, CSV export (customer_id, route, tokens)
- Trace hooks (light): sampling toggle, API v1 endpoints, backend event emission, smoke test
- Attribution: route-level logic, weekly reconciliation job that flags >10% drift
- Error clusters: grouped errors view, quick-link to sample trace, retention & redaction by default
- Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with autosafe rollback on guardrails

Sam: Perf tests: small/med/large payloads (64/512/2048 tokens). Must measure obs.trace_hook.exec_ms and overall request p95. Define baseline runs and compare.
Jordan: Guardrails to monitor during canary: p95 latency, error rate, CPU, token-cost delta, and attribution job failures. If any breach sustained for 15m -> rollback.
Maya: Legal/compliance: exports that include customer identifiers may need suppression in certain regions. I'll get list of regulated regions and flag export toggles.
Lina: UX acceptance: show a small annotation if data is estimated due to sampling. Also include a help link explaining attribution margin of error.
Alex: API sketch for cost export:
POST /api/v1/cost/export
{
  "since": "2026-03-01",
  "scope": "customer,route",
  "format": "csv"
}
Server should validate scope and return 403 if export prohibited for that customer/region.

Sam: For trace hooks telemetry, we need an event schema: sample_id, route, customer_id (hashed optional), sample_reason. Retain events 30d.
Jordan: Ops needs a canary dashboard with quick playbook: where to look, owners to page, and rollback button. I'll draft the runbook.
Ria: Great. Let's agree on what we cut for GA vs follow-ups. Cuts (post-GA): per-token cost breakdown by model type, scripting hooks, real-time attribution recalculation, advanced error analytics facets.
Maya: Customer comms ask: call out known limitations in GA release notes (sampling, estimation, region export limits) and include contact path for higher-fidelity billing.
Lina: I'll add microcopy for limitations on the card and a CTA for CS.
Alex: Owners and deadlines: Alex = cost card + export (PRD by Wed), Sam = trace hooks + perf harness (branch by Tue), Jordan = canary + runbook (doc by Wed), Lina = mocks + microcopy (OKR sync Fri), Maya = compliance list + release notes (ASAP). Ria to own release decision.
CI-bot: deploybot: staging canary started at 1797770200, smoke tests queued.
Sam: I'll wire a quick synthetic generator to hit sampled routes at 5k rps for smoke.
Jordan: Reminder: set automated alerts to page on-call only after 25% cohort if we see sustained regressions.
Ria: If no objections, I'll lock GA scope as above and update the roadmap slice. Quick thumbs?
Alex: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup:
Lina: :thumbsup:
CI-bot: deploybot: staging smoke tests passed at 1797770500. No regressions observed.
